title: Flag at a Glance
description: A dashboard is only as trustworthy as its weakest render — if the API says a flag is on, the badge on screen had better agree. Cross-check the Feature Flags panel's rendered badges against the raw API response.
successCondition: GET /api/admin/feature-flags is called directly and its flags object is compared field-by-field against the Badge tone/text rendered for each flag row on the Admin console's Feature Flags panel — every key's UI state ("on"/success vs "off"/neutral) matches the boolean the API returned for that same key.
hints: Fetch the API response first so you have a ground truth to diff the UI against.
docs/api/admin.md documents the exact flag keys and their env var naming if you want to sanity-check a self-hosted instance's configuration too.
